transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I don't know. I guess... nothing really feels like mine anymore. 

I used to get excited about things. Checking out murals, going for runs, basketball... even just making a good drink at work. But lately I just... I just stand there. Like I don't care about any of it. 

So... that's why I'm here, I guess.
How long have you been feeling this way?
A couple of months, I guess. Ever since the bar got bought out. They came in and... everything I'd been working toward just changed. So, yeah. Two months.
Do you still enjoy activities that you used to find pleasurable, or has the pleasure gone away?
I mean... like I was just saying. It's gone. The basketball, the running, making drinks... I just don't care about any of it anymore. There's just... nothing there.
Do you feel sad most of the time?
I don't know if sad is the right word. I'm not... crying or anything like that. It's mostly just... like I said, just flat. I don't really feel much of anything at all.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or enjoy doing?

Not really. Like I said... it's all just kind of gone. I used to paint murals, go for runs, shoot hoops... even just mixing a good drink used to be something. But now... I don't know. I just stand there. Nothing feels like mine anymore.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from things that normally would give you pleasure?
Yeah... I mean, I thought I just said that. I just... I don't get anything out of the stuff I used to like. The murals, the running... none of it. It's just flat.
Do you feel hopeless or depressed most of the time?
I guess... yeah, maybe. It's just... I don't really see the point in much of anything anymore. It's all just kind of... heavy.
Do you feel like you have less energy than you used to?

Yeah. I guess. Work's... harder. By the time I carry a couple cases of liquor out front, or just set up the well... my body feels like I've already worked a double. And that's even if I barely did anything else that day. So... yeah. Just tired.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?

I don't know about the weight, exactly. I don't really weigh myself. But... I guess I'm not eating much. Most days I just sort of... forget. Until my hands start shaking when I'm trying to pour a drink behind the bar. Then maybe after closing I'll try to force down a few bites of whatever's cold in the back, but... honestly, just looking at it makes me feel kind of sick. So, yeah. Probably lost some weight.
Have you had any thoughts of death or suicide?
No. I... no. Not really. Just... tired, like I said. That's all.
Have you had any difficulty concentrating or making decisions?

I suppose. It's... yeah. Inventory used to just be automatic. Now I'll just stand there staring at the bottles in the well. I end up losing count two or three times. And... I don't know. Even simple stuff. I'll just freeze up trying to figure out what garnish needs restocking. Just... hard to think straight, I guess.
Have you had any periods in the last two months where you felt somewhat better for a few days?
I don't think so. No. It's all just... been about the same, really. Every day.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than you used to?
No. I don't... I don't think so. I haven't really noticed anything like that. Just moving normal, I guess.
Have you had any periods in the last two months where you felt completely back to your normal self for at least two weeks?
No. Not really. It's... no. Like I just said, it's pretty much been the same this whole time. I haven't felt normal.
Have you had any significant changes in sleep patterns since you started feeling this way?

Yeah, I guess. I mean... I'm tired when I lie down, but my head just keeps going over things. Every little mistake I made at work, mostly. And then... when I finally do get to sleep, I usually wake up around four or five. Can't really get back down after that.
Do you feel like you're resting or sitting still more often than you used to?
I don't think so. I mean... I sit when I'm at home, but... no more than usual, I guess. Just regular.
Have you had any days in the last two months where you felt no sadness or emptiness at all?
No. I don't think so. It's just... kind of always there. Not really any days off from it.
Have you experienced a lack of interest in activities for most of the day, every day, for the past two months?

Yeah... I guess so. That's kind of why I came in. Just... nothing really feels like mine anymore. I used to get excited about things. Looking at murals, going for runs... basketball. Even just making a good drink at work. But now... I don't know. I just stand there. I don't really care about any of it.
Have you had any periods in the last two months where you felt even slightly better for a few days, but not necessarily back to your normal self?
No... not really. It's just been the same.
Have you had any days in the last two months where you felt almost back to your normal self?
No... I haven't. Not at all.
